steps.content: I've already agreed to send him away! What more do you want!?
I'm going right now! Happy?
A shrill voice echoes from the hallway. You quickly pull Lore-Ley behind the bushes of a small flower bed.

The next second, a young woman emerges from the hallway. She angrily hangs up the call and rams the device into her pocket. In her other hand, she is carrying a pet carrier and a large, bulging canvas bag.
When Lore-Ley sees the young woman's face, she lets out a small gasp and nods at you. It's definitely Ada!
But when her gaze shifts to the woman's protruding belly, Lore-Ley's eyes widen in surprise.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: She's...?
You gesture for Lore-Ley to be quiet and wait until the pregnant woman walks a bit further before quietly trailing behind her.
That's Ada, right?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Yeah. She's grown a lot, but I can still recognize her... What she's holding? Could it be Cabbage?
I know it's not good to make you follow and track someone with me... But she's your friend, right?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Friend... Yes, I want to be her friend.
Then let's follow her... and don't tell Nightingale.
You follow Ada down a block. She storms forward furiously, seemingly clear about her destination. Finally, you see her enter a pet store.
You and Lore-Ley exchange a puzzled look and follow her inside.
You go to a corner, pretending to browse the pets while secretly keeping an eye on Ada.

steps.speaker: Store Manager
steps.content: Good afternoon. Buying something for Cabbage? We just got some new pet shampoo. It's on sale now, wanna get some?
The store manager greets Ada warmly. It's obvious that she's a regular customer at this store.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: ...I'm afraid I won't need it anymore.
Ada sighs and places what's in her hand on the counter. She unzips the pet carrier and takes out a white puppy.
The puppy is clearly well-cared for, with bright eyes and neatly groomed snow-white curls.
However, his left front leg is shorter than the others, making it hard for him to walk. He hobbles over to lick the store owner's hand affectionately.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: What happened to Cabbage's leg!? He didn't have an injury before!
Lore-Ley covers her mouth, whispering in surprise. You signal her to stay calm and continue listening.
A melancholy Ada gently strokes Cabbage, but soon she sneezes, her face bright red. She takes out a mask in exasperation and puts it on tightly.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: You know, ever since I got pregnant I've become allergic to Cabbage. My family knew and has been urging me to give him away.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: The symptoms weren't too severe at first. I just sneezed occasionally, so I was able to hold off their pressure. But these days, it's impossible.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Cabbage has been with me for so many years. He's long been like family to me. Plus, he has a heart condition and injured his leg. How can I trust others to take care of him? Will they care for him as I do?
Seeing Ada break out in red patches, the store owner quickly takes Cabbage and puts him on the counter, then gives some ointment to Ada and leads her to a breezy area near the entrance.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: The whole house has been in chaos for days. They threatened that if I don't send Cabbage away immediately, they'll get rid of him themselves.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: I've been arguing with them every day over this, but it really can't continue like this...
She touches her belly.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: After all, since I've decided to have this little one... I have to be responsible for it.
The store manager stays silent for a moment, then sighs.

steps.speaker: Store Manager
steps.content: So... what are you planning to do?

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: I know this might be a bit presumptuous, but... can I leave Cabbage here for a while? I'll look for someone to adopt him, and I'll cover all his expenses before that happens...

steps.speaker: Store Manager
steps.content: Money's not the main problem. I'm worried that given his health problems, it would be hard to find him a new home. Most people want a healthy puppy, right?
The store owner looks at the puppy on the counter and whistles loudly. The puppy, oblivious to his future, responds happily, wagging his tail and turning in circles.

steps.speaker: Store Manager
steps.content: But don't worry, I'll take good care of him. I'll also keep an eye out for a new owner...
Wow! What a cute puppy! He can even spin in circles!
You suddenly hear a young voice ring out. A child rushes up to the counter like a whirlwind, her eyes sparkling as she gazes at Cabbage.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Sir, miss, can I hold this puppy? I really like him!
After being momentarily stunned, Ada smiles and nods, letting the store owner carefully place Cabbage into the little girl's arms.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Of course, but please be careful and hold him steady. His legs have some problems.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Yeah, I'll be careful.
The girl teases Cabbage while giggling.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Miss, what's the puppy's name?

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: His name is Cabbage.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Wow, what a cute name! Just as cute as he is!

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Miss, I heard that you're looking for a new home for him?

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Yes. I'm pregnant, so I can't continue to take care of him. We need to find him a new owner who can.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Ah, I see...
The girl nods thoughtfully as a couple walks in.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: How many times have I told you not to run so fast? Look at you, you're all sweaty.
The woman bends down lovingly to wipe the sweat from the girl's forehead as she reprimands her. The man, carrying many shopping bags, nods in agreement.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Yes. You're making Mommy worry.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Sorry, Mommy and Daddy. I saw a really cute puppy, so I just had to rush in.
The girl proudly lifts the puppy in her arms up to the couple.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Look! His name is Cabbage. Isn't he cute? He's looking for a new home. Can we take him home?
The man's gentle expression freezes when he notices the puppy's missing foreleg. His face darkens, and he becomes stern.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: You can have a pet, but definitely not this dog!
The girl seems startled by her father's sudden change. She takes a while to respond, pouting in confusion and dismay.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Why?

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Can't you see he's crippled!?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: So what? I really like him. I'll take good care of him!
As the girl argues with her dad, she casts a pleading look at her silent mother, but doesn't get the support she wants. The woman sighs, avoiding the child's gaze.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: You say you'll take good care of him. Maybe you can do that for a day, a week, or even a month. But what happens after a year or two?
The woman squats down and lovingly strokes the girl's head, trying to comfort her.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Taking care of a sick puppy is as time-consuming and demanding as taking care of a sick person. You're still young. You can't fully comprehend these responsibilities...

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: But, I can do a lot of chores now! I can definitely take good care of him! Just let me...
The girl wants to argue more, but gets cut off.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Sweetie, don't be stubborn. No matter how much you love him or promise to never abandon him right now, you'll get tired of him over time.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: You'll have to spend a lot of time taking care of him. You might not have time to go out with other kids or watch TV or play. Instead, you'll have to stay with him for his treatment. Is that what you want?

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Plus, you'll need to buy him medicine, take him to the vet... your pocket money might not be enough. You won't be able to buy your favorite snacks and toys like now. Is that okay with you?

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: And the harsh truth is, no matter how well you take care of him, his condition won't improve. He'll be like this for the rest of his life. He won't be able to go outside to run and play with you...

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Are you sure you won't resent him someday for these issues? Are you sure you won't see him as a burden and regret your decision?
The woman rambles on with her reasons, barely caring if the girl understands. She exchanges looks with the man, as if recalling a painful memory.
The girl finds herself unable to answer her mother's questions and lowers her head in frustration.
The man steps forward and lovingly pats her shoulder.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Mommy and Daddy have been through this. We know how tough it is.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Listen to Mommy and Daddy. Choose a healthy puppy, and grow up happily with it. You have so many choices. Why choose one that might make you regret it in the future?
The girl clenches her fists. She looks at the puppy, then at her father, making a final plea, but eventually slumps her shoulders in defeat.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Okay...

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Thatta girl. Our good girl.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: There there, don't be sad. Come, we'll get your favorite snacks from the supermarket, then Daddy will pick out the best beef and make your favorite stew!

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: R-Really?
Hearing these words, the girl's eyes light up instantly. She seems to forget all her previous disappointments.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Of course. When has Daddy ever lied to you?
The woman pats her daughter's head with a smile.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Since you want a puppy so much, have you thought about which breed you want?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Huh? Do different breeds have differences besides their looks?

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Of course! Like their temperament, habits, and so on. Different breeds of puppies are very different from each other.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: I see...

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Why don't we go home and do some research together? After all, choosing a puppy to join the family is a big decision!

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Sure! Mommy, you're the best!
Ada and the store owner watch the family leave in silence. Only Cabbage continues to wag his tail eagerly, unaware of why he was suddenly left behind.
The woman's words, though harsh and heartbreaking, are grounded in reality. But you feel more regret and pity for the puppy, and start to worry about his future.
The atmosphere is so silent that you almost forgot you had a companion.
Lore-Ley?
You call out to her but get no response. She hangs her head in silence, her hair drooping down and covering most of her face.
What's wrong? Are you feeling unwell? Come, let's go and hydrate you before they notice us.
She doesn't answer you. After a long silence, she slowly utters some jumbled words.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: When I was young, they treated me with the same gentleness and patience... Ha, I almost forgot.
...What?
You don't immediately understand her, but instinctively feel a wave of unease.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: You can't believe it, can you?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: What a coincidence. Those two... are my parents.
